Comment: Panasa Platform Upgrade Workflow (CLAUDE.md Section 14 Phase 15). Started directly via stepfunctions:StartExecution from POST /api/v1/platform/upgrade (app.modules.platform.upgrade_orchestrator) — unlike the agent deployment workflow, there is no EventBridge indirection and no customer-CI/CD boundary here: upgrading the Factory's own ECS service is this Runtime's own operational concern (see version_service.py's docstring). Any failure rolls the ECS service back to the pre-upgrade task definition — 'Platform rollback: revert ECS task definition to previous image digest' is the MarkUpgradeFailed branch, not a separate user-triggered action.

PullingImage.Comment: Confirms the target image tag/digest actually exists in ECR before touching ECS at all.

RegisteringTaskDefinition.Comment: Clones the current task definition with the target image (+ PLATFORM_VERSION env var) as a new, immutable revision. Records both ARNs — the new one for UpdatingService, the previous one for rollback.

UpdatingService.Comment: ECS's own deployment configuration (minimumHealthyPercent/maximumPercent) performs the zero-downtime rolling replacement — this stage just points the service at the new revision and waits for it to stabilize.

PlatformHealthCheck.Comment: GET /api/v1/platform/health on the Runtime's own ALB endpoint (Section 5.6 — a GET, unlike the agent pipeline's POST /health per F1) — confirms the new version is actually serving before declaring success.

MarkUpgradeFailed.Comment: Terminal failure — rolls the ECS service back to previous_task_definition_arn (a no-op if RegisteringTaskDefinition never ran) and records failure_reason.
